name: enterprise-plan-band
title: Enterprise band
description: The 'need more?' band under the plan cards: what large buyers ask for, who it suits, and a direct line to sales.
docs: Pass title, description, capabilities (an icon, a label and an optional line that makes it concrete), contact (email and phone), note and action. The capabilities are plain text with a decorative icon, the email and phone are real mailto and tel links, and the action is any element, normally a large Button, that fills its panel. The band follows its own width: capabilities in three columns beside the panel when it is wide, and one column on a phone with the action coming before the list. The panel on the right holds the button, the contact lines and the note on who the plan suits, such as Usually teams of 200 or more. labels translates the line above the contact details.
